title: Sub-account per agency, number purchase and release, number registration, country switch (G1)
goal: Give each agency its own compartment at the phone provider and let it buy, use and release numbers safely, only in countries where calling is offered.
why: ADR-001 section 6 items 2-3 and 11: no sub-accounts; DELETE /voip/numbers/:id removes only the DB row and never releases the number (provider keeps billing, routes/voip.ts ~495-523); purchase does not register the number in tenant_channel_addresses; calling is offered regardless of country.
steps: Master 0023: voip_accounts (tenant_id PK, provider, sub_account_id, credentials_enc, status, created_at), call_country_policy (country PK, position resell|bridge|own_account|not_offered, provider, notes) seeded from the per-country table in the ADR-001 addendum (provider column from the addendum, not Plivo; the Gulf, Thailand, Sri Lanka, Nepal and Bangladesh not_offered as in ADR-001 section 4 unless the addendum changes it), number_documents (tenant_id, country, status, files JSON) for KYC uploads.

Enable calling for an agency (admin endpoint + super admin action): checks the country policy and plan (no calling on trial), creates the sub-account via the provider (G1 provider), stores credentials encrypted.

Numbers: number rental is an add-on priced at provider monthly cost + margin (comm_unit_costs channel phone_number, R109 pricing.ts), shown before purchase; purchase only when KYC documents for that country are approved (status set by the super admin) and the agency holds a number add-on (granted by the super admin or bought through R206); sets callbacks, inserts tenant_channel_addresses; release calls provider.releaseNumber then removes the row (and refunds nothing); cancellation of an agency schedules release after a grace period with notice email.
Desktop: phone numbers page shows price, KYC status and upload, release with useConfirm; VoIP settings hide calling when the policy is not_offered and show the reason.
tests: backend/test/voip-numbers.test.ts (mock provider + mocked fetch for the G1 provider): trial cannot enable calling; AE agency gets not_offered; purchase without approved KYC -> 409; purchase consumes the number add-on and registers the address; release calls the provider before deleting; inbound to the new number resolves the agency.
acceptance: No path deletes a number row without releasing it at the provider (test).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/voip-settings.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: Provider account per the ADR-001 addendum, KYC process per country, India legal opinion, written confirmation from the provider about sub-accounts for resale.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.

Read docs/decisions/ADR-001-voip.md (sections 4, 6, 7), its addendum when it exists (the owner could not sign up with Plivo; the addendum settles the default provider, likely Twilio where it can serve, with India handled separately), and docs/CALL-AUTOMATION.md (sections 2, 3, 4). Everything here stays behind the VoipProvider interface; do not design around Plivo. Calls are included in plans with a monthly minute cap (owner decision 2026-10-14).
Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md (ds-* tokens, archetypes, graceful degradation when VoIP is not configured). lint-gate must not rise for any touched file.
Blocked on G1: start only when the owner has chosen the provider and the India shape (ADR 9a items 1-4, 7).
ownerDecisionNote: G1 decided 2026-10-15: Twilio only (sub-account per agency) outside India; no calling for agencies in India, the Gulf, Thailand, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bangladesh at launch.
